svg.title: Bots, the main bot and helpers
svg.desc: In the Mac app, a bot asks the main bot for a new bot, the main bot creates bots, and bots write to each other; the app passes these on by reading swarmhub blocks in replies. On the Herdr server each bot has one agent, and an agent starts helpers through the bridge, which picks their model from the helper policy.

svg.text: A bot is a record in the app. The app reads the swarmhub blocks in a finished reply and acts on them.
